question_text: A newly appointed undersecretary owns a 30% share in a logistics company that has contracts with several government agencies. Under RA 6713, Section 9, what must he do to comply with the divestment requirement?

options.text: He must resign from his position within 30 days.
He must sell his shares within 60 days from assumption of office.
He must transfer his shares to a relative within 90 days.
He must divest his interest within 90 days from assumption of office, either by selling or by relinquishing control.
